title: 第15章 离别之吻，九州创投初现！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    银色法拉利360 MOdena在深南大道上撕开一道低沉的声浪。

    流线型的车身在夕阳下折射出冰冷的金属光泽，惹得路口的私家车纷纷减速避让。

    车厢内，冷气开得很足。

    包裹性极强的真皮座椅散发着高级定制特有的味道。

    沈曼坐在副驾驶上，目光总是有意无意地往旁边飘。

    林川单手握着方向盘，另一只手随意地搭在车窗边缘。他开车的姿势很放松，没有那种暴发户刚摸到超跑时的紧绷和炫耀感。

    就好像这辆三百八十万的猛兽，在他手里真的只是个代步工具。

    沈曼的脑子里，不受控制地回放着刚才在名车汇展厅里的一幕幕。

    那个不可一世的王老板，自己扇自己耳光的滑稽模样。

    名车汇少东家顾城，那种顶级圈子里的公子哥，主动递上名片结交时的姿态。

    这一切的中心，都是身边这个穿着没有任何lOgO黑T恤的年轻男人。

    他到底是什么人？

    沈曼的手指不自觉地收紧，掐进了自己的掌心。她见过太多有钱人，但那些人要么恨不得把身家贴在脑门上，要么就是满嘴跑火车的油腻老男人。

    像林川这种，把欲望说得坦荡，花钱连眼睛都不眨一下，还带着几分痞气的男人——对任何一个有野心的女人来说，都是最危险的毒药。

    “晚上要飞？”林川看着前方的路况，随口问了一句。

    “嗯。”沈曼收回视线，手指无意识地绞着真丝裙的下摆，“晚上八点的航班，飞京城。连飞三天。”

    她的语气里，带着一丝连她自己都没察觉到的失落。

    今天是休息的最后一天，本来她还盘算着，晚上怎么也该有个像样的收尾。但偏偏遇上了排班。

    她偷偷看了一眼林川的侧脸。

    这男人应该会挽留一下吧？或者说几句漂亮话，比如“真舍不得你走”之类的。

    “那还真是有点可惜。”林川嘴角微微上扬。

    “可……可惜什么？”沈曼的脸腾地烧了起来。

    “本来还说晚上一起看电影来着。”林川的声音带着调笑的意味，他侧头看向沈曼，“不然嘞，你以为可惜什么？”

    沈曼愣了一下，马上明白过来。

    自己被耍了。

    “你太讨厌了，我才没有想什么！”

    “哈哈哈——”

    两个人在车里笑成一团。

    车子稳稳停在航空公司协议酒店的楼下。

    低沉的发动机轰鸣声瞬间吸引了酒店大堂内外不少人的目光。

    刚好有一组拉着飞行箱、穿着制服的空姐从大堂里走出来，准备上公司的接驳大巴。

    领头的，正是那天在航班上和沈曼一起值班的乘务长陈璐，还有另外两个年轻空姐。

    “卧槽，法拉利！”一个年轻空姐压低声音惊呼，眼睛都直了。

    陈璐也停下脚步，目光在那辆银色跑车上扫过。但下一秒，她的视线僵住了。

    副驾驶的车门推开。

    一条白皙修长的腿先迈了出来，紧接着，是穿着黑色真丝吊带裙的沈曼。

    陈璐猛地瞪大了眼睛。

    车厢里。

    沈曼没有立刻关上车门。她站在车外，微微弯下腰，看着驾驶座上的林川。

    夕阳的光晕打在她的锁骨上，整个人像是镀了一层蜜色的光。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The silver Ferrari 360 MODena made a deep sound on Shennan Avenue.

The streamlined body reflected a cold metallic luster in the setting sun, causing private cars at the intersection to slow down and avoid it.

In the carriage, the air conditioner is turned on very well.

The highly wrapped leather seats exude a unique taste of advanced customization.

Shen Man was sitting in the passenger seat, his eyes always drifting to the side intentionally or unintentionally.

Lin Chuan held the steering wheel with one hand and rested his other hand casually on the edge of the car window.His driving posture is very relaxed, without the tight and showy feeling that the nouveau riche had when they first got their hands on a supercar.

It’s like this 3.8 million beast is really just a means of transportation in his hands.

In Shen Man’s mind, the scene in the famous car showroom just now was replayed uncontrollably.

That arrogant Boss Wang, the funny look of slapping himself.

​​ Gu Cheng, the young master of Mingchehui, is the kind of young man in the top circles who takes the initiative to hand over his business card to make friends.

The center of all this is the young man next to him wearing a black T-shirt without any logo.

Who is he?

Shen Man's fingers tightened unconsciously and pinched into his palm.She has seen too many rich people, but those people either want to put their wealth on their foreheads, or they are greasy old men who talk about cheating.

A man like Lin Chuan, who openly talks about his desires, spends money without batting an eyelid, and has a bit of a ruffian spirit - is the most dangerous poison to any ambitious woman.

"Are you going to fly at night?" Lin Chuan asked casually as he looked at the road ahead.

"Yeah." Shen Man looked away, his fingers twisting the hem of the silk skirt unconsciously, "The flight is at 8 o'clock in the evening, flying to the capital. It will fly for three days."

There was a trace of disappointment in her tone that she was not even aware of.

Today is the last day of rest. Originally, she was planning to have a decent ending in the evening.But it just happened to be scheduled.

She secretly glanced at Lin Chuan's profile.

This man should be able to stay, right?Or say a few nice words, such as "I really can't bear to let you go" or something like that.

"That's really a pity." Lin Chuan raised the corners of his mouth slightly.

"But...what's a pity?" Shen Man's face burned up.

"Originally, we said we would watch a movie together in the evening." Lin Chuan's voice was teasing. He turned his head and looked at Shen Man, "Otherwise, what do you think is a pity?"

Shen Man was stunned for a moment and understood immediately.

"I was fooled."

"You're so annoying, I didn't think anything of it!"

"Hahaha——"

The two people laughed together in the car.

The car was parked steadily downstairs at the hotel contracted by the airline.

The low roar of the engine instantly attracted the attention of many people inside and outside the hotel lobby.

Just then, a group of flight attendants in uniforms carrying flight cases came out of the lobby, preparing to board the company's shuttle bus.

The leader was the flight attendant Chen Lu, who was on duty with Shen Man on the flight that day, and two other young stewardesses.

"Damn it, Ferrari!" A young stewardess exclaimed in a low voice, her eyes widening.

Chen Lu also stopped and glanced at the silver sports car.But the next second, her vision froze.

The passenger door opened.

A pair of fair and slender legs stepped out first, followed closely by Shen Man wearing a black silk suspender skirt.

Chen Lu's eyes suddenly widened.

In the carriage.

Shen Man did not close the car door immediately.She stood outside the car, bent slightly and looked at Lin Chuan in the driver's seat.

The halo of the setting sun hit her collarbone, and her whole figure seemed to be coated with a layer of honey-colored light.
